jobs.name: Timber Forwarder

Travel pose crane folded forward above the bunk, no loose cables. Exactly one cabin and one crane. Rear is log bunk tailgate with red lamps and towing eye. In AT WORK, at a pine forest lakeshore, vehicle stays on firm land with wheels grounded, crane grips one fallen trunk and visibly lifts it into the bunk; guarded cutting head clearly identifiable. No snowy truck blade deck and no trailer.

No humans, no lava, no floating components. Strong distinctive tracked quarry silhouette.

jobs.name: Reef Salvager
jobs.description: Underwater Refuges. Compact four-wheel underwater dock salvage crawler, exactly two axles and four broad dark rubber driven wheels. Sealed rounded capsule-like cobalt-blue DRY cabin with thick circular cyan viewport in front, one small round porthole on each side, watertight rear hatch, orange protective ring frame. It travels inside protected dry underwater dock halls, not freely swimming or flying. Single orange telescopic crane mounted to rear-center frame; folded claw secured over enclosed navy mixed-cargo locker in travel views. Two simple white work lamps flank front circular viewport; rear has small red lamps and rear hatch, no duplicate front viewport. In AT WORK, machine is wholly on a dry stone dock inside a clear protective underwater habitat hall; its long crane reaches through an open work aperture over turquoise water and lifts a metal salvage crate from just beneath water, wet claw above crate, visible grounded wheels. A simple glass habitat wall behind shows underwater blue beyond; no human/pet swimmers, no propellers, no breathing meter. Clearly mechanical salvage utility.

jobs.name: Skybridge Carrier
jobs.description: Sky Islands. Low wide compact rail-guided cargo carrier, four small paired top-running wheels, captive orange U-shaped guide bogies with small dark rollers UNDER both rail lips to keep it attached to an existing bridge rail. It is a bridge vehicle, never free flight: no wings, no rotors, no balloons. Short squat blue glazed driving cabin at FRONT; rear is broad flat navy cargo platform with three strapped beam/stone crates and a single small orange folding crane mounted just behind cabin, folded lengthwise over deck in travel pose. Four cardinal studio views show a short cutaway sample of two parallel silver bridge rails under wheels so under-rail rollers are clearly visible and coherent, no giant train wheels. In AT WORK on a completed wooden sky bridge between grassy floating island edges, captive rollers engage the rails, crane lifts a crate toward a safe freight platform. Entire vehicle supported by bridge; clear stationary working pose, no free-floating cargo, small clouds well below.

jobs.name: Forge Hauler
